ruleDefinitions.name: DNS Query To AzureWebsites.NET By Non-Browser Process
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a DNS query by a non browser process on the system to "azurewebsites.net". The latter was often used by threat actors as a malware hosting and exfiltration site.
 Note: Unmapped fields: QueryName

sequences.query: QueryName = RGX("azurewebsites\\\.net$") AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome\.exe") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox\.exe") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeWebView\\\\Application\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsApps\\\\MicrosoftEdge\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$"))) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\safari\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MsSense\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\BraveSoftware\\\\")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Maxthon\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\maxthon\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\Opera\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\SeaMonkey\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\SeaMonkey\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\seamonkey\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Vivaldi\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Naver\\\\Naver\\ Whale\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Naver\\\\Naver\\ Whale\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\whale\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Tor\\ Browser\\\\.*") OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Waterfox\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Waterfox\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\Waterfox\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Programs\\\\midori\\-ng\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\Midori\\ Next\\ Generation\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\SlimBrowser\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\SlimBrowser\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\slimbrowser\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Flock\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\Flock\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Phoebe\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\Phoebe\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Falkon\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Falkon\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\falkon\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\
